verses.1: A word from Jehovah to David: Who will dwell in your tent? Who will rest on your holy mountain?
verses.2: He walks in purity, acts justly, and speaks truthfully.
verses.3: He did not do any harm to his enemy. He did not cause any suffering or humiliation to his opponent.
verses.4: His eyes are filled with sorrow; he will not honor the sight of Jehovah. He will slander and speak evil of others.
verses.5: He did not give them any reward; he only caused harm to those who were innocent. Such people will never be rewarded in this world.
